evidence: app/package.json:10-20 — pins @sveltejs/kit ^3.0.0, svelte ^5.57.1, vite ^8.3.0, adapter-node ^6: the whole app rests on a major version stable since 2026-10-01
app/vite.config.js:5-13 — Kit 3's new-in-vite-plugin config style (sveltekit({ adapter, compilerOptions })), mandatory since svelte.config.js was dropped
app/vite.config.js:6-9 — parametric `runes: ({ filename }) => ...` compile option, a stable compiler feature shipped ~2026-03 (svelte 5.57)
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:2-3 — only long-stable Svelte/SvelteKit APIs (onDestroy, untrack, goto)
reach.rationale: No experimental/preview APIs at all, but the app centrally rides a major framework release that went stable four weeks before review (plus a ~7-month-old parametric compile option), which fits 'recently-stable APIs in central places'.

evidence: app/vite.config.js:5-13 — the only 'new' surface (Kit 3 plugin config, runes forcing) is confined to one config block plus package.json
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:1-80 — data layer is plain fetch + Map cache, framework-version-independent
containment.rationale: Nothing experimental exists to contain; the recently-stable framework surface is inherent to every route and cannot be contained further, and the one optional modern feature (runes forcing) sits in a single config block with a removal note.

evidence: app/vite.config.js:5-13 — vite-plugin config + adapter is the only way to configure Kit 3; not a choice
app/vite.config.js:7-9 — runes forcing buys compile-time enforcement of runes mode for first-party code, with an honest 'can be removed in svelte 6' comment
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:3 — $app/state page is the only page store left in Kit 3 ($app/stores removed)
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:68 — error(404, 'Not found') uses the currently recommended (status, message) signature
justification.rationale: No experimental APIs are used; each recently-stable choice is either mandated by the current stable release or a small, justified hardening measure. Notably it did NOT reach for Kit 3's preview remote functions for data fetching, keeping the plain load()/fetch layer.

findings.issue: goto() is called with Kit-2-era options { keepFocus: true, noScroll: true, replaceState: true }; Kit 3 removed noScroll/keepFocus in favour of reset: false (throws error goto_options_removed in dev, silently ignored in prod, so scroll and focus reset on every debounced search/filter commit) and deprecated replaceState in favour of replace. Same pattern at app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:12-15.
findings.suggestion: Replace both call sites with `goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true })`.

findings.issue: Forcing runes mode via the parametric compile option is redundant here — every first-party component already uses runes, so Svelte auto-detects runes mode — and adds a config knob to remember to delete in Svelte 6.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as a guardrail; alternatively drop the runes option and rely on auto-detection (the comment acknowledging removal in svelte 6 is good).

findings.issue: The app depends on majors that all reached stable within the last ~8 months (Kit 3.0 on 2026-10-01, Vite 8.0 on 2026-03-12, adapter-node 6), so routine minor upgrades may surface follow-up breakage; no experimental flags are involved, so risk is limited to normal young-major churn.
findings.suggestion: Keep the lockfile committed (it is) and expect Kit 3.x minors; nothing else to do.

summary: The app is deliberately conservative: it adopts the current stable SvelteKit 3 / Svelte 5.57 / Vite 8 stack and uses zero experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs — no remote functions, no experimental compiler flags. Its only 'new' APIs are newly-stable ones (Kit 3's vite-plugin config and #lib imports, the parametric runes compile option), all justified and confined to config. The one real defect is the opposite of experimentalness: leftover removed goto options (keepFocus/noScroll, deprecated replaceState) that break intended scroll/focus behavior in production and throw in dev.

experimentalApis.api: goto options { keepFocus, noScroll } (removed in Kit 3, replaced by reset)
